prose: Basis: the Washington Post page returned an error, so this note rests on Techmeme's account. Cathedral, a months-old cybersecurity startup founded by former DOGE staffers, says it breached Anthropic's internal systems in under 12 hours using AI agents. According to a report reviewed by the Post, the startup told the Claude maker that its researchers quickly penetrated sensitive systems - a claim that, if borne out, is an awkward look for the AI lab most identified with safety, in the very week of its IPO filing.
